# Abuzar Zulfiqar

> AI/ML Engineer in Lahore, Pakistan (open to relocation worldwide, on-site, hybrid or remote). Builds production AI agents, RAG assistants, LLM automation and MLOps on Azure and AWS for founders, CTOs and product teams. Open to consulting engagements, senior roles and partnerships.

## Profile
- Name: Abuzar Zulfiqar
- Role: AI/ML Engineer | AI Agents, RAG & LLM Automation | Independent AI Engineer
- Location: Lahore, Pakistan. Open to relocation worldwide and to remote work.
- Experience: 3+ years in production Generative AI (Rolustech, OptimusFox), independent since Aug 2026
- Capacity: takes on larger projects with a small team of engineers, staying the single technical lead and point of contact
- Education: BS Computer Science, FAST-NUCES (2019-2023)
- Certification: Microsoft Certified Azure AI Engineer Associate (2024)

## Skills
AI agents, agentic AI, LangGraph, LangChain, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), Azure OpenAI, OpenAI API, GPT-4, Llama, tool calling, structured outputs, text-to-SQL, n8n, Python, FastAPI, Pydantic, PostgreSQL, Redis, Pinecone, FAISS, AWS (Lambda, SQS, S3, API Gateway, CloudWatch, CloudFormation), Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitHub Actions, MLOps, LLMOps, LLM evaluation, PII redaction, observability

## Selected results
- Cut p50 processing latency from about 126 s to 4 s across 1.24M records (AWS, PostgreSQL)
- Delivered 25+ RAG knowledge assistants; about 40% lower inference latency and 35% lower LLM API cost
- Agentic insurance-appeal drafting workflow (LangGraph, Azure OpenAI): 60-70% less drafting time
- Conversational BI assistant with text-to-SQL: about 60% less manual analysis
- Meeting intelligence automation from call recordings to Salesforce
